summary: SOS Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, covering Q2 2026 results and subsequent events. The filing details ordinary share-capital changes, including Class A and Class B reductions, cancellations, and a share subdivision dated July 27, 2026, alongside warrant and private-placement disclosures. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private deal—is present. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a standard periodic update, offering no risk-arb angle or event-driven catalyst.
